title: ReuseBrief
description: What a job built on creative the person already has is going to do with it: which asset, what it is for, which platforms it is being adapted to, and what will and will not be changed. It takes the place of a strategy set on the existing creative route, and it is what the person approves at the concept gate before any caption is written.

asset_ids.description: The finished assets this job reuses, as registered asset ids or workspace paths.

objective.description: What this creative is being used to achieve, in the person's terms.

adaptations.description: One entry per platform this creative is being adapted to.

changes.description: What is being changed for this platform: crop, subtitles, cover frame, caption angle. An empty list means posted as it is.

restrictions.description: Brand or claim restrictions that still apply to creative made earlier.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences the approval screen shows.
